title: Bounded state after a call frame
statement: Let a machine state have location and memory values in $\mathbb Z$, and let the word bound be $W$. Suppose every location and memory value in a state $\sigma$ has absolute value at most $W$. For a list of expressions that are safe in $\sigma$, form a new location function by placing their values, in order, at the corresponding indices and assigning $0$ at indices beyond the list; retain $\sigma$'s memory. The resulting state has every location and memory value bounded in absolute value by $W$.
hypotheses_covered: Every location and memory value of $\sigma$ has absolute value at most the word bound
Every expression in $\text{args}$ is safe in $\sigma$
